text: ここの　みせで　めずらしい　ものを　かうのが　つう　の　トレーナーだぜ！

structure.jp: ここの　みせで　めずらしい　ものを　かうのが
structure.en: buying rare things at this shop

structure.jp: つう　の　トレーナーだぜ！
structure.en: is what a Trainer in the know does!

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. めずらしい ものを かうの = 'buying rare things'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, boyish talk that pushes the statement with confidence. つう の トレーナーだぜ = 'that's a Trainer in the know, man'.
